entities.summary: Gordon Douglas "Don" Lusher was an English jazz and big band trombonist best known for his association with the Ted Heath Big Band. In a career spanning more than 60 years, he played trombone with a number of jazz orchestras and bands and was twice president of the British Trombone Society.
